phases.name: Initialization & Architecture Gates
phases.objective: Initialize the child project, establish hybrid provider/security architecture and complete technology consent before product implementation.
exit_criteria: Child state and CI are healthy
Provider architecture and data/threat boundaries are documented
Technology stack receives required owner approval before product code starts

phases.name: Realtime Audio Commercial Core
phases.objective: Deliver the platform-independent realtime audio foundation, hybrid routing and first usable accent/audio path.
exit_criteria: Realtime audio can run through safe virtual routing
Initial audio enhancement/accent provider path is verified
Base SaaS/telemetry/release foundation exists

phases.name: Translation & Live Transcription
phases.objective: Add realtime translation, captions, diarization and final transcript reconciliation.
exit_criteria: Translation and transcription paths meet approved quality/latency targets
Live and final transcript states reconcile

phases.name: Meeting Intelligence & Multi-Platform Capture
phases.objective: Capture meetings across major surfaces and convert them into useful meeting artifacts.
exit_criteria: Initial meeting platforms capture reliably
Notes/summaries/actions are source-traceable
Initial mobile/browser/in-person capture path is verified

phases.name: Commercial SaaS & Business Integrations
phases.objective: Commercialize access and connect conversation outcomes to customer work systems.
exit_criteria: Entitlements and usage are metered correctly
Initial CRM/calendar/email/chat integration pack is revocable and auditable

phases.name: Conversation Intelligence & Enterprise
phases.objective: Add contact-center intelligence, QA/compliance and enterprise administration.
exit_criteria: Initial telephony/contact-center path is stable
QA/compliance scores link to evidence
Enterprise identity/fleet policies are enforceable

phases.name: Unified Knowledge & Agentic Automation
phases.objective: Create cross-app knowledge and safe authorized action execution.
exit_criteria: Cross-app search inherits source permissions
AI actions require correct scopes/approvals and are auditable/idempotent

phases.name: Live Assistant & Telephony Expansion
phases.objective: Expand realtime communication coaching and contextual assistance.
exit_criteria: Live assistance meets approved latency/factuality controls and cannot break base call audio

phases.name: Proprietary VSN AI Expansion
phases.objective: Build VSN-owned models as first-class providers without blocking the initial hybrid commercial path.
exit_criteria: Approved datasets/compute/provenance exist
VSN models pass benchmark and security gates before production routing

phases.name: Developer Platform
phases.objective: Expose stable internal capabilities through secure public APIs, SDKs and webhooks.
exit_criteria: Public contracts are versioned, secure, metered and documented

work_units.title: Project governance, bootstrap and consent
work_units.objective: Complete governance readiness while keeping product implementation consent-gated.
acceptance_criteria: Project identity/state is reconciled and consent boundary is enforceable
required_checks: ANPOS repository-integrity validation

work_units.title: Desktop audio core and virtual devices
work_units.objective: Deliver verified realtime desktop audio capture/routing and safe virtual devices.
acceptance_criteria: Approved desktop calling apps can consume processed audio with safe bypass
required_checks: latency/jitter/device lifecycle compatibility tests

work_units.title: Realtime audio enhancement
work_units.objective: Deliver noise/background-voice/echo cleanup through hybrid provider contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Audio enhancement improves clarity and degrades safely on provider/runtime failure
required_checks: objective/subjective audio and CPU/latency benchmarks

work_units.title: Accent conversion and voice preservation
work_units.objective: Deliver initial verified accent conversion using available providers while preserving speaker identity.
acceptance_criteria: Initial target accent path meets approved intelligibility, identity and latency thresholds
required_checks: listening, speaker-similarity, accent and latency benchmarks

work_units.title: Realtime speech translation
work_units.objective: Deliver verified bidirectional speech translation through normalized provider adapters.
acceptance_criteria: Approved language pairs are understandable and provider/session provenance is traceable
required_checks: translation quality, code-switching and latency tests

work_units.title: Live transcription, captions and diarization
work_units.objective: Deliver streaming/final transcript and speaker-aware caption pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Live transcript streams reliably and final output can reconcile provisional words/speakers
required_checks: WER/cpWER, overlap/noise and multilingual tests

work_units.title: Meeting capture and platform connectors
work_units.objective: Deliver authorized meeting capture abstraction across initial conferencing platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Initial platform capture/join/webhook flows are reliable and revocable
required_checks: platform matrix, OAuth revocation and webhook idempotency tests

work_units.title: Meeting intelligence and knowledge
work_units.objective: Generate source-traceable notes, summaries, decisions, actions, highlights and meeting Q&A.
acceptance_criteria: Meeting artifacts remain traceable to transcript evidence and respect permissions
required_checks: factuality, extraction and permission tests

work_units.title: Live AI assistant and communication coach
work_units.objective: Deliver opt-in realtime contextual assistance and coaching.
acceptance_criteria: Suggestions arrive within approved latency and cannot block base audio
required_checks: latency, factuality and prompt-injection tests

work_units.title: Hybrid AI provider gateway and orchestration
work_units.objective: Create provider-neutral capability registry, adapters, routing, health, fallback and policy control.
acceptance_criteria: Third-party and VSN providers can implement the same capability contracts without domain rewrites
required_checks: adapter contract, failure/fallback, rate-limit and telemetry tests

work_units.title: Proprietary VSN AI runtime and model registry
work_units.objective: Deliver approved dataset/evaluation/model lifecycle and VSN provider runtime.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned VSN model can plug into the provider gateway with benchmark/rollback evidence
required_checks: dataset provenance, leakage, model regression and artifact integrity tests

work_units.title: Voice personalization, identity safety and voice security
work_units.objective: Deliver safe voice profiles, verification and spoof/deepfake risk controls.
acceptance_criteria: Voice personalization is consent-bound and security events are auditable
required_checks: authorization, deletion/revocation, spoof/deepfake and abuse tests

work_units.title: Telephony and contact-center integrations
work_units.objective: Deliver initial SIP/PSTN/contact-center realtime media integration.
acceptance_criteria: Initial telephony media path is stable and failures degrade safely
required_checks: codec, packet loss, DTMF, fraud/rate-limit and call lifecycle tests

work_units.title: SaaS web app, accounts, teams and workspace
work_units.objective: Deliver secure user/org identity and core conversation workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant isolation and secure desktop/web identity linking are verified
required_checks: auth, RBAC, E2E, accessibility and responsive tests

work_units.title: Subscriptions, entitlements and usage metering
work_units.objective: Deliver reliable subscription state, quotas, entitlements and AI usage ledger.
acceptance_criteria: Usage is idempotently metered and billing/entitlement state reconciles safely
required_checks: billing sandbox, metering and quota-boundary tests

work_units.title: Admin, analytics, observability and cost control
work_units.objective: Deliver provider/product health, latency, usage and cost observability.
acceptance_criteria: Provider cost/latency is attributable and sensitive content is redacted from telemetry
required_checks: observability coverage, alert and cost reconciliation tests

work_units.title: Privacy, security, compliance and data governance
work_units.objective: Establish enforceable threat, consent, retention, encryption, residency and tenant-data controls.
acceptance_criteria: Sensitive data classes and trust boundaries are explicit and enforceable
required_checks: security, tenant isolation, consent and privacy deletion/export tests

work_units.title: Quality, performance, release and desktop updates
work_units.objective: Deliver product-specific test/release/signing/update/rollback assurance after technology approval.
acceptance_criteria: Critical flows, latency budgets, installer/update and rollback paths are verified
required_checks: CI, audio benchmarks, E2E, security and install/update/rollback tests

work_units.title: Public developer API, SDKs and webhooks
work_units.objective: Expose approved stable capabilities via versioned developer interfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Public contracts are secure, metered, rate-limited, signed where applicable and documented
required_checks: contract, load, security and SDK compatibility tests

work_units.title: Multi-platform clients and in-person capture
work_units.objective: Deliver initial mobile/browser/in-person capture surfaces with secure sync.
acceptance_criteria: Supported clients capture/sync reliably and honor permission revocation
required_checks: platform, lifecycle, sync, CPU/battery and permission tests

work_units.title: Business integrations and workflow automation
work_units.objective: Deliver a revocable integration foundation for calendars, email, chat, CRM, documents and automation systems.
acceptance_criteria: Initial integrations use least privilege and external writes/sync are idempotent and auditable
required_checks: OAuth, webhook replay, sync-conflict and rate-limit tests

work_units.title: Conversation intelligence, QA and compliance scoring
work_units.objective: Deliver evidence-linked configurable scoring and manager QA workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Scores/flags link to evidence and configurable scorecards are versioned
required_checks: precision/recall, bias/error, permission and audit tests

work_units.title: Unified conversation knowledge and cross-app search
work_units.objective: Deliver permission-aware semantic retrieval across conversations and connected work systems.
acceptance_criteria: Search spans only authorized sources and answers cite source evidence
required_checks: retrieval relevance, permission leakage, citation and deletion-propagation tests

work_units.title: Agentic actions, AI skills and voice agents
work_units.objective: Deliver scoped, approval-aware and auditable agentic actions over the integration/knowledge foundation.
acceptance_criteria: Actions execute only within scope, approvals are enforced and retries cannot duplicate side effects
required_checks: tool authorization, prompt-injection, idempotency and approval-bypass tests

work_units.title: Enterprise administration, device fleet and deployment control
work_units.objective: Deliver enterprise identity lifecycle, fleet inventory, policy and staged deployment controls.
acceptance_criteria: Enterprise identity/policy/device lifecycle is predictable and auditable
required_checks: SSO/SCIM, RBAC, fleet policy and deployment rollback tests

phase_template.objective: Outcome boundary for a group of modules/work units.
